classification: ACTUAL NATIVE CURRENT-TREE CHILD EXECUTION; operator-recorded native tool calls and shell receipt files. Not fixture inference.
measurement: Sender host monotonic timestamp immediately before issuing native tool call; receiver first observable shell action timestamp. Includes sender model/tool scheduling and receiver inference/tool delay. Upper bound on processing start, not server-internal dispatch latency. Sender-return observation also includes parent model/tool delay, so is not precise RPC latency.
idle_state_evidence: list_agents showed recipient completed READY_IDLE before followup_task.
active_state_evidence: list_agents showed recipient running after ACTIVE_READY before send_message.
replacement_state_evidence: interrupt_agent returned previous_status running; replacement completed REPLACEMENT_READY_IDLE before followup_task. Same logical message replaced-one remained pending through generation change.
sender_nonblocking: Native calls returned without recipient final-response result. Sender executed independent arithmetic/file commands without awaiting final responses; recipients produced final notifications separately. Timing alone is not RPC blocking proof.

sender_return_observed.note: Sender executed this without awaiting recipient final response.
Independent command executed without awaiting recipient response.
Sender did not wait for replacement response.

scope_limit: Tools address existing non-root child agents in the current native agent tree. Arbitrary unrelated Cloud chats or top-level ROOT cannot be addressed/awakened by this interface. Do not represent current-tree child wake as arbitrary-session wake.
production_routing: Use followup_task for both idle and running recipients; native service handles wake-or-steer. send_message alone only used in the active-delivery experiment; not safe for production due active-to-idle race.
delivery_semantics: Durable enqueue before transport, current-generation routing, pending until acknowledged, retry/redelivery after replacement. One logical ack is idempotent; no claim of exactly-once arbitrary business side effects.
